channel.description: Latest articles from Covering Katy News (coveringkaty.com)

item.title: Visit Sugar Land launches FIFA World Cup 26 planning portal for Fort Bend area fans
item.description: Soccer fans planning to attend World Cup matches in Houston next summer can now access a central resource for Sugar Land events and activities through a new planning portal launched Thursday by Visit Sugar Land.

item.title: Katy ISD Santa Cops Program Brings Holiday Cheer to 740 Students
item.description: KATY, Texas (Covering Katy News) — The Katy ISD Police Department's Santa Cops program delivered gifts to 740 students across more than 400 families this holiday season, ensuring hundreds of children will have presents to open during the holidays.

item.title: Fulshear Police Investigate String of Vehicle Burglaries; Suspects Flee After High-Speed Chase
item.description: The Fulshear Police Department is investigating a series of vehicle burglaries and attempted vehicle entries that occur during the overnight hours near Primrose Valley Lane and Texas Heritage Parkway, as well as in the Camber Ridge Apartments area.

item.title: Greenhouse Road Sidewalk Project to help Katy and Cy-Fair ISD students
item.description: A new four-mile sidewalk along Greenhouse Road will give students a safer path between Katy and Cypress-Fairbanks independent school district schools, eliminating a dangerous route that has forced children to walk along roadway shoulders and open dit

item.title: More build-to-rent homes coming to Katy area
item.description: A Chicago developer has acquired land in the Katy area for its second large-scale build-to-rent community in Harris County.

item.title: City Council rejects plan to replace tennis courts with pickleball courts at Katy City Park
item.description: The Katy City Council rejected a proposal, submitted at its Dec. 9 meeting, to turn two of six tennis courts at Katy City Park into pickleball courts.

item.title: Man Mauled to Death by Three Dogs on Katy Hike and Bike Trail
item.description: A 62-year-old man was mauled to death by three dogs on Mason Creek Hike and Bike Trail in Katy Monday morning. The dogs also attacked a woman and child.

item.title: Brookshire celebrates Christmas season with parade, toy drive
item.description: The City of Brookshire celebrated the start of the Christmas season by hosting its annual Christmas parade and festival Saturday.

item.title: Katy City Council sets special city council election for Jan. 31, 2026
item.description: Katy City Council sets Jan. 31, 2026, special election to fill Ward A seat vacated by Dan Smith. Filing deadline is Dec. 22. Four of five council seats will turn over by next summer due to term limits.

item.title: Three Arrested in $90,000 Armored Car Robbery at Katy Asian Town H Mart
item.description: Three men have been arrested in connection with the robbery of a Brinks armored car at the H-Mart supermarket in Katy's Asian Town that netted approximately $90,000, according to the Harris County Sheriff's Office.
